LanguageData.SGQ_DescriptionTotal: The quota is the total number of each item allowed across this entire vanilla storage group. Excess is hauled outside the group.
LanguageData.SGQ_DescriptionSimilar: The quota is the maximum amount in one stack. The group keeps at most {0} independent similar stacks; excess total quantity is hauled outside.
LanguageData.SGQ_RebalanceStatus: Stacks waiting to be split or merged: {0}
LanguageData.SGQ_NoOverflow: No overflow in this storage group.
LanguageData.SGQ_ZeroHelpTotal: 0 means unlimited. Items inherit the nearest configured category, then the global default.
LanguageData.SGQ_ZeroHelpSimilar: 0 uses each item's native stack limit. Items inherit the nearest configured category; total = per stack × N.
LanguageData.SGQ_CategoryQuotaTooltip: A category value is inherited separately by each descendant item; it is not one shared total for the category.
